name: Build a podcast transcript library in Google Sheets from RSS feeds with Apify

parameters.content:
## Build a podcast transcript library in Google Sheets from RSS feeds

### How it works
This workflow collects the transcripts that podcast publishers already attach to their RSS feeds (the Podcasting 2.0 `<podcast:transcript>` tag) and saves each new episode as one row in Google Sheets: title, date, speakers, word count, transcript link and the full text. It never transcribes audio, so it is fast and cheap, but episodes whose show does not publish a transcript are skipped. Buzzsprout, Omny Studio and many Podcasting 2.0 hosts publish them; many large shows do not.

Each run reads the episode GUIDs already in your sheet and appends only new episodes, so you can schedule it daily. Long transcripts are cut at 45,000 characters to fit a Sheets cell (`textTruncated` = true; the full file stays at `transcriptUrl`).

The Apify step runs the paid Apify Actor "Podcast Transcripts from RSS", published by this template's author (Apify Store: ahmed.fouaad82/podcast-published-transcripts). The first 25 saved transcripts of every run are free; beyond that it is pay-per-transcript (see the Actor's Pricing tab). `maxCostPerRunUsd` caps what one run can charge.

### Setup
1. Apify: create a free account, copy your API token, then create an n8n **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer {{APIFY_TOKEN}}` (replace the placeholder with your token). Select it in **Fetch published transcripts**.
2. Google Sheets: connect your credential in both Sheets nodes. Create a tab named `Transcripts` whose first row is: `guid, publishedAt, podcastTitle, episodeTitle, episodeNumber, durationMinutes, wordCount, speakers, language, transcriptUrl, audioUrl, feedUrl, textTruncated, text, savedAt`.
3. In **Podcast settings** paste your feed URLs and spreadsheet ID, then click **Run now** and check the sheet.

### Customization
Raise `maxEpisodesPerFeed` to backfill older episodes, set `publishedSince` (e.g. 2026-01-01), or send the new rows on to a vector store for RAG.

## 1. Settings and checks
Edit only **Podcast settings**. The check node stops the run before any paid work if feeds or the sheet ID are missing.

## 2. Fetch published transcripts
One synchronous Apify run returns all new episodes as JSON. A failed run stops the workflow with the reason and writes nothing.

## 3. Skip known episodes and save
Episodes are matched on their RSS GUID, so repeated runs never duplicate rows.

### Cost cap
`maxCostPerRunUsd` is sent to Apify as the run's charge limit. Keep `maxTranscriptsPerRun` at 25 to stay inside the free slice.
